title: Japan 10-Year JGB auction — the benchmark tenor, and the only JGB arm MOF has not cut (-3.7% since 2024 against the super-long's -30% to -57%)
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (english/policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,188 bytes) by the jgb-30y-auction-2026-11-10 initial research; its table row reads 'Nov. 5, 2026 | 10-year'. NO SIZE IS ASSERTED: no November row carries an 'Auction Announcement' href on 2026-09-09 and MOF's own note on the page reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date', putting terms around 2026-10-29. ¥2,600bn is the anticipated base case from MOF's Auction Results for JGBs workbook (english/policy/jgbs/auction/past_auction_results/Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls, 492,032 bytes, last saved 2026-08-13, parsed 2026-09-09), whose 10年債 sheet shows ¥2,700bn from 2024-01-10 and ¥2,600bn at every auction from 2024-04-02 through 2026-07-02 — one step, at the start of the window. Filed `estimate` on the two counts every JGB entry on this calendar records: the size is anticipated rather than announced, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Discovered during the jgb-30y-auction-2026-11-10 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09) on MOF's own November calendar; it sits D-5 from the proposing event, inside the corridor, and is the only JGB tenor in that corridor this calendar does not already track. IT IS PROPOSED FOR ONE MEASURED REASON: it is the control arm the retired difference-in-differences actually needed. jgb-40y-auction-2026-11-25 retired the 'the 40-year is the untapered control' design because the control took the larger dose of the OTHER policy — MOF cut the 40-year -44.6% over the comparison window against the treated 20-year's -18.8%. Measured this session from the same workbook over 2024-01 -> 2026-07, the issuance path by tenor is 10Y ¥2,700bn -> ¥2,600bn (-3.7%), 20Y ¥1,000bn -> ¥700bn (-30.0%), 30Y ¥900bn -> ¥600bn (-33.3%), 40Y ¥700bn -> ¥300bn (-57.1%). The 10-year is the one arm MOF has effectively left alone, and a newly issued 10-year sits in neither of the two BoJ purchase buckets the family's mechanism claim is about ('more than 10 and up to 25 years', tapered -55%, and 'more than 25 years', flat at ¥150bn/month for 32 months). THE HONEST LIMIT ON THAT RATIONALE, STATED UP FRONT: this session did NOT read the BoJ's own purchase path for the 5-10y bucket, so 'untreated' is established against the super-long taper only and not against BoJ policy in general — that is the first thing the 10-year's own initial research should measure, and if the 5-10y bucket was tapered too the control rationale weakens rather than disappears. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is low for the reasons all sibling JGB ledgers record: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
